name: token-saver
description: Token-saver mod: quiet bash, trim output, cache band, /tokens, cold-cache compaction veto, keep-warm pings

quietBash.title: Rewrite noisy bash
quietBash.description: git status/log and test commands become short reporters before they run.

trimOutput.title: Trim huge successful output
trimOutput.description: Head+tail of huge successful stdout. Failures are left intact.

cacheBand.title: Cache band above the prompt
cacheBand.description: CLI and Desktop only. VS Code panel does not draw mod UI.

compactHint.title: Cache-aware hint on the band
compactHint.description: Fat and warm: /compact is cheap. Fat and cold: /clear, do not /compact. Never types into the box.

compactGuard.title: Veto /compact on a cold cache
compactGuard.description: Manual /compact is refused when the prompt cache has gone cold, with the re-send cost named. Auto-compaction is never blocked. Override once with: /compact force

longCacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL is 1 hour
longCacheTtl.description: Off: 5-minute TTL (Claude Code's default). On: 1-hour TTL. Sets when the band and the compact guard call the cache cold.

keepWarm.title: Keep the prompt cache warm while you are idle
keepWarm.description: API billing with the 5-minute TTL only. Shortly before the cache lapses, re-reads the session's own cached prefix with one tiny request (about 0.1× its input price) so your next message hits the cache instead of paying a 1.25× re-write. Stops after the cap, on any miss, and never runs during a turn. Pings and their cost show in /tokens and the Context pane.

keepWarmPings.title: Keep-warm pings per idle stretch
keepWarmPings.description: How many pings, about 4 minutes apart, before letting the cache lapse. 5 keeps it warm for about 20 minutes, the break-even if you come back half the time. 0 turns keep-warm off.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest parked skills for this repo at session start
suggestSkills.description: Reads package.json, Package.swift, pyproject, Cargo.toml, go.mod and html for signals and names parked skills that fit. One UI line, no tokens. /loadout suggest [topic] on demand.

inputPricePerM.title: Input price, $ per million tokens
inputPricePerM.description: Used only to put dollars on the Context pane's savings (cache reads at a tenth, trimmed tokens kept out of every turn, re-caches avoided). 0 shows tokens only. Check your model's current price before setting it.

cardBars.title: Card bars in the Context pane
cardBars.description: Fire: the cards' cell bars burn like the context bar. Ember: the same cells with a calm glow at each head and no wind, so only the context bar moves.
